changelog.summary: Adds a supplier-aware, integer-recomputable reorder proposal from a location-specific inventory signal, with separate PO and transfer proof.

title: Inventory Risk to Reviewed Replenishment
description: Turn a Shopify item and location stock risk into a supplier-aware reorder proposal, then distinguish purchase-order status from actual receipt.
setup_prompt: Use Inventory Risk to Reviewed Replenishment as a chat-led proposal for one authorized Shopify variant, inventory item, destination location and supplier. Discover Catalog & Merchandising Analyst and Replenishment Planner Crews; propose reuse or reviewed creation. Inspect location-level available stock, confirmed incoming and open purchase orders, demand window, supplier lead time, minimum order, case pack, cost/currency, budget policy and procurement owner. Show the recomputable quantity/cost handoff, owner review, manual first run and separate purchase-order and transfer verification. Selecting this Playbook does not create a PO, order from a supplier, receive inventory, spend money or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized store, market, product, variant, inventory item and destination location
Demand window, current available, backorders, confirmed incoming and open PO/transfer evidence
Supplier ID/SKU, lead time, review interval, MOQ, case pack, unit cost and currency
Procurement owner, safety stock and budget/approval policy
Manual-only or reviewed inventory-change trigger and notification route

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated item/location risk artifact

recommended_tools.name: Shopify orders or demand export
recommended_tools.purpose: Count units for the agreed comparable demand window

recommended_tools.name: Supplier, purchase-order or ERP records
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify terms, open orders, incoming transfers and later supplier confirmation

pulse_focus.label: Supplier replenishment review
focus_areas: Whether item/location stock risks have a justified reorder quantity and owner
Whether ordered units and actual received units remain separate
review_when: Demand, available, incoming or supplier terms change; a proposed PO lacks owner decision; ordered units miss expected receipt

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and inventory/supplier authority map
Recomputable reorder or defer review with unknowns
Separate approved PO and transfer receipt when later executed
